title: Guest Scrape Save reads memberships from a stale cached profile
surface: Scrape Save Source and Unsaved retry
auth_mode: guest after saved sign-in restoration fails
preconditions: Chrome has a retained user profile on this device but the extension is visibly in guest mode after sign-in restoration fails.
The unpacked development extension is on an ordinary HTTPS article page with a capture and an in-memory article edit.
reproduction: Open the owned Matrx Extend demo page in Chrome and capture it in the Scrape tab.
Edit the article markdown, Apply, then open Save as a Source and press Save Source.
Observe the Not yet a Source card and press Retry save while still signed out.
expected: Both Save and Retry keep the edited capture locally and show a clear sign-in remedy without calling organization membership or landing endpoints; after sign-in, Retry can land as the verified user.
actual: The edited capture remains local, but Save and Retry display `permission denied for function mbr_for_user` instead of a sign-in remedy. Retry reproduced after a full extension reload, with the Unsaved card intact; no Source is shown as landed. The native observation is bound to development v0.2.509 from CI source cd6c43815, not to the published Store package.
cause: The Save/Retry send path tests the cached profile as if it proved current authentication. The UI correctly treats the failed bearer restore as guest, so the stale profile can reach organization resolution and the membership RPC.
severity: S2: a signed-out person cannot understand or complete Scrape Save retry after an expired or failed session; the draft is retained
priority: P1: fix the shared Save/Retry identity boundary and retest guest and signed-in transitions
review: Fresh independent source review passed A correctness and B evidence after the guarded RED/GREEN/mutation/compile report. Exact-main CI at 3e5b8f182 passed and its v0.2.509 development artifact was promoted on disk; Chrome loaded state is not verified.
next_action: Retest the original stale-profile guest Save and refused Retry using an owned disposable fixture on the latest loaded development artifact: prove edited draft retention, sign-in remedy, no guest organization/landing call, full extension reload, and signed-in Retry landing the edited text. The public demo queue is now empty after one authorized Retry and canonical Source 7f70b11a-d5ab-4153-af6c-b4b33d0953d5 is recovered; preserve that Source, do not Retry the empty queue or archive/delete the recovered Source. Current signed-in Retry/readback is surrounding evidence only, not guest original reproduction or D217 closure.
